notes: Reply length is now yours to set, per conversation. The menu inside each chat offers Brief, Short, Medium or Long — one line at the tightest, several paragraphs at the loosest — and it is remembered for that chat alone, so a quick back-and-forth with one character and a long scene with another can sit side by side. The setting moves the instruction and the token ceiling together, since asking for a paragraph while capping the budget just cuts a reply off mid-sentence, and it phrases itself differently for texting and in-person, where a beat of a scene is not the same unit as a text message. Existing chats are unchanged: Short is the default and matches how replies have always been written.
